svg.title: Itojinsei — The Iron Loom. Draft 4 / Magnet classification / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 recalibration).
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Taut Filament forks into Razor Strands then Severing Lattice, or Threadbound Vigor then Weaver Ascendant. Tangling Snare forks into Constricting Coils then Iron Cocoon, or Conductive Seam then Galvanic Marionette. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Magnet jutsu.

The Control trait reaches potency through two universal Decrease Damage Given rows (Wire Blast Plus 30%, an ally-hazard circle; Eternal Embrace 35%) and one 35% Increase Damage Taken row on Lightning Threads. The kit has no Decrease Damage Taken, Reflect, Lifesteal or Heal row, so there is no defensive route: the wielder root Taut Filament carries the Damage and Increase Damage Given routes, the control root Tangling Snare the Decrease Damage Given and Increase Damage Taken routes. Changes: Taut Filament loses +2% IDT; Threadbound Vigor +2% \u2192 +3%; Weaver Ascendant IDG +3% \u2192 +5%; Tangling Snare DDG +3% \u2192 +2% and gains +2% IDT; Constricting Coils +2% \u2192 +3%; Iron Cocoon DDG +4% \u2192 +5%. Capstone secondaries are +2%: Weaver Ascendant and Iron Cocoon add exposure, Galvanic Marionette adds suppression. Maxima over every legal allocation: Damage +5, IDG +10%, DDG +10%, IDT +10%.","Arithmetic and filters (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73/\u00a73b): each jutsu IDG/IDT row multiplies a matching hit in turn (\u00d7(1 + p/100)) and each DDG row reduces it in turn (\u00d7(1 \u2212 p/100)), so same-tag rows compound rather than sum; the bloodline-sourced 25% + 0.15/level IDG passive applies last. Spiraling Wires' IDG row (Bukijutsu/Speed/Strength, no element) reaches any Bukijutsu-typed or element-less hit, weapons and basic attacks included; Eternal Embrace's any Lightning, Magnet, Wind or element-less hit. Both DDG rows (four stat types, no element) reach every non-pierce hit; nothing here touches pierce.","Delivery and uptime: every cast is cooldown 7; every percentage row is live the two rounds after its cast round, never on its own hit. Iron Web Entrapment (line), Wire Blast Plus (circle spawn), Spiraling Wires and Lightning Threads (single) cost 60 AP, so one Damage cast fits a 100 AP turn, with room for Eternal Embrace (40 AP circle spawn). All five are OTHER_USER: any living non-caster user, an ally included, is a legal target; SELF rows land on the caster either way.","Fourth purchases: Burst takes Tangling Snare (suppression 32%/37%, exposure 37%) or Threadbound Vigor (buffs 40%); Amplifier takes Tangling Snare or Razor Strands (47/42/42/42 EP); Suppression takes Taut Filament (buffs 37%) or Conductive Seam (exposure 42%); Exposure takes Taut Filament or Constricting Coils (suppression 37%/42%). All 14 full allocations are non-dominated and every node appears in one; four examples, one per capstone."],"risks":["Self-buff reach: both Increase Damage Given rows reach beyond the kit (Spiraling Wires: any Bukijutsu-typed or element-less hit; Eternal Embrace: any Lightning, Magnet, Wind or element-less hit), so the +10% maximum raises normal jutsu, weapons and basic attacks in each window; where the windows overlap both apply (\u00d71.45 \u00d7 1.45 \u2248 \u00d72.10, against \u00d71.82 at base), before the bloodline-sourced 25% + 0.15/level passive applies last. Uptime not simulated.","Ally hazard: Wire Blast Plus row 1 (Decrease Damage Given) is an OTHER_USER AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN with friendly fire none (=ALL), so allies in the radius-1 circle also receive the debuff; the caster is never a target of an OTHER_USER area jutsu (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a74b). The suppression route takes it from 30% to 40%; Eternal Embrace's row is friendly fire ENEMIES. Positioning decides.","Exposure concentration: Increase Damage Taken has one row (Lightning Threads, 60 AP, single target, 2 rounds); the exposure route reaches 45%, amplifying player, weapon and ally Lightning, Magnet, Wind or element-less non-pierce hits once per 7-round cast.","Damage concentration: +5 EP lands on four Magnet rows, the widest Damage reach in this tree; the hits are formula-calculated and the IDG passive multiplies them, so +5 EP is not +5 damage. Not simulated.","Eternal Embrace delivery: the self IDG row is realized on the caster at cast time (actions.ts 980\u20131004/1060\u20131075; SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73b) whenever the OTHER_USER circle spawn has a legal target, an ally included; not positional, no ground effect. The DDG row (friendly fire ENEMIES) hits each living enemy in the radius-1 circle once and is withheld from allies. Buffprevent is unsupported.","Classification: Magnet is shared with Houkyuken (expected under RUL-2026-10-03-005). 6 of 9 kit rows carry Magnet; the three element-less rows (Wire Blast Plus and Eternal Embrace suppression, Spiraling Wires' self buff) need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver. Off-kit Magnet coverage is unverified.","No defensive route: the kit has no Decrease Damage Taken, Reflect, Lifesteal or Heal row, and the 15% Lightning Decrease Damage Taken passive is not a jutsu row, so every build is offense or control; stun (Iron Web Entrapment), redirection (Spiraling Wires), decrease-heal (Lightning Threads) and buffprevent (Eternal Embrace) receive nothing.","Context: skill-tree and bloodline effects are suppressed in ranked PvP and ranked sparring; normal-tree potency policy is unapproved (combined stacking audit required). g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Magnet jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE ITOJINSEI KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Draft 4 / Magnet classification / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 recalibration)
